title: Pro API Featured Chains Configuration
description: Maps chain identifiers (any string keys) to featured-chain settings, including which Pro API plans may use the chain and the credits multiplier for its requests.

additionalProperties.description: Featured-chain settings for one chain identifier.

plans_allowed.description: Pro API plans that are allowed to use this featured chain.

credits_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the credits cost of every request to this chain. Defaults to 1.
